patch.value: Resumable since delta packs with substantive messages and claims

Add context-pack since with opaque retained-history cursors, bounded substantive comment and handoff excerpts, ranked changes and claims, strict output budget and omission receipts; measure against the core activity retry and comment-read route on a public tracker copy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked: core context --for handoff is a current-state snapshot, activity digest/compact omits patch comment text, and pm-brief brief since already classifies lifecycle, priority and dependency changes but has no durable cursor, substantive comment excerpts or claim continuation. Implement only the missing resumable delta serving surface over SDK activity plus the existing certified complete item reader. Keep tracker/history semantics in the SDK. Plan non-git/no-git-PATH regressions, behavioural revert proof and public-copy three-call completeness/token comparison.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented the since surface with SDK history replay, registered relationship ordering, content-addressed retained cursors, snapshot paging and exact whole-response byte-token ceilings. Six real-SDK regressions pass, including a built extension in a non-git tracker with an empty executable PATH, indirect unblock detection, cross-agent claims, substantive prose, deterministic retries, paginated completeness and typed retention remedies. Public-copy benchmark and unchanged full gates are running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional strict health inspection currently fails on existing package state: pm-github expects host 2026.10.21 while the repository pins 2026.10.15, and health reports merge_fence_drift:2. Stale work and legacy provenance are advisory. Preserve the dependency pin and existing history; queue rules forbid merge-fence work. Treat health as a separate unresolved CI gate, not as evidence against since behavior. Full release gates remain mandatory and unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proof: replaced only classify substantive-prose extraction with the prior omitted-text behavior, rebuilt dist, and ran node --test --test-name-pattern "real tracker delta includes lifecycle|installed built command works" test/since.test.ts. Exit 1: both selected regressions fail at missing comment kind/text, including the installed no-git CLI assertion. Restored the exact source and rebuilt. The eight-scenario focused run before this control passed 8/8 with native lines, branches and functions at 100 percent. Separate health follow-up: pm-context-595f remains open; no dependency or merge-fence repair performed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Fair public-copy measurement complete: 1261 existing items at public commit 8ce50f94e5dcbeec5b5874dbf990c73a9e9d4b18, CLI 2026.10.21 and pinned SDK 2026.10.15. Each of two simulated sessions resumes with one call rather than three. Actual o200k_base output tokens: 496 to 371, then 540 to 373; all matching event identities and complete new substantive comments retained, no deferred rows. Reproduction and limits are documented in docs/since-benchmark.md; raw tracker artifacts remain ignored. The initial mismatched setup boundary was discarded. Source/none linked-test configuration was refused; rerunning source/schema as required by the host execution-context contract.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Linked execution passes: pm test pm-context-8bbh --run --progress --workspace-context source --pm-context schema --timeout 600, 8/8 tests, zero failures or skips. Initial source/none was a host configuration refusal; source/schema at the default 120 seconds timed out under concurrent host load, then passed with an explicit 600-second bound. Test-result tracking is disabled and was not changed, so this comment preserves the receipt. CLI JSON stderr also carries the typed code and next_steps via the SDK expected-error contract. Implementation is frozen; clean-HOME npm and Bun release gates remain the final verification work.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final contract review found an empty-refresh edge case: content-identical state could return the input cursor. Added a deterministic checkpoint generation so every successful response advances to a distinct opaque token, while retries of the same input remain identical. Added explicit empty-refresh and retry assertions to the existing regression. Stopped only the task-owned in-flight gates and will rerun both against the corrected committed tree; earlier partial runs are not acceptance evidence. Native Bun installed-extension no-git acceptance passed 2/2 before this metadata-only cursor change.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Empty-refresh regression passes: the successful next cursor differs from the input even with no changes, and retrying the original cursor is byte-identical. The corrected classifier remains identical to the behavioural-revert control. Re-running the checked-in public-copy benchmark and both full release gates on the corrected source; no merge, release or item closure.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Added a concurrent-writer interleaving regression: another agent takes a claim after the metadata read but before the history snapshot. Own claims now come from that same SDK replay snapshot, preventing a stale own-claim reminder alongside the competing claim event. This preserves SDK-owned claim semantics and only changes the read projection. Final verification includes this ninth real-tracker scenario and the empty-refresh cursor assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Lifecycle boundary regression reproduced a false reopen/reprioritization when a terminal item was deleted; the guard now requires a real resulting status/priority. The regression failed before the fix and passed afterward, retaining its new pre-deletion comment text. Derived unblocks also exclude closed/deleted waiting items. Delta rows now include type and status so the core digest metadata is preserved, and the benchmark oracle checks those fields. A final complete focused run and both full gates are being rerun; partial superseded runs are not counted.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The complete focused suite passes 10/10 at native 100 percent lines, branches and functions. Additional comment-identity control reproduced a real same-time duplicate: set comparison hid the second identical comment. Switched to multiplicity-aware comparison, preserving separate additions and suppressing already-seen copies; the new assertion failed before the fix. This changes prose selection only for duplicate objects, preserving ordinary-session output. Lifecycle, claim snapshot and cursor corrections remain covered by the same ten scenarios.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final public-copy runner result after preserving core metadata: 1261-item committed public tracker, CLI 2026.10.21, two sessions, calls 3 to 1, actual o200k_base tokens 499 to 385 then 543 to 386 (22.8 and 28.9 percent lower). Full matching event identities, substantive text and type/status/title checks pass with zero deferred rows. These figures supersede the earlier narrower-output measurement. Multiplicity-aware comment regression now passes; all SDK reads invoke normal directory/item read hooks. Freeze this source for unchanged clean-HOME npm and detached same-head Bun release checks.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final dependency projection now reports an item unblocked only after every prerequisite clears, and emits one actionable row when several blockers clear together. Partial removal remains blocked; later closure/deletion/reblocking ranks prior unblock rows last. The multi-edge regression also supplies complete SDK dependency metadata. Cursor retention now tolerates snapshot entries disappearing during enumeration, covered by a real missing-target filesystem case. No changes to SDK versions, history anchors or merge configuration.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Current complete source passes all ten focused real-tracker scenarios with native 100 percent lines, branches and functions, including the SDK history-policy preflight, partial/multiple blocker cases and vanished snapshot entries. The preflight delegates policy/read hooks to the public SDK activity API; physical reads preserve per-stream append order. Final actual-function revert control restores only addedProse from the earlier commit and must fail the same-time duplicate assertion; restore/rebuild before full gates. Call/token figures concern agent invocations and output, not internal I/O count or latency.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Real SDK blockedBy probe confirmed that a free-text blocker leaves lifecycle status open and writes only blocked_by. Cover that supported blocker shape as well as dependency edges. Own-claim reminders must carry current blocker state so an unchanged blocked claim is not presented as actionable on the next empty refresh. This is the final read-projection correction before locked full gates; no tracker history rewrites.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Locked source acceptance now passes 10/10, zero failures/skips, with native lines/branches/functions all 100 percent. The supported blockedBy reason remains lifecycle-open in the SDK; it is now detected, and unchanged own-claim snapshots show blocked=true plus current bounded blocker context. Current metadata seeds items without history streams; streamed items use authoritative SDK replay. Typed refusal, no-git installed CLI, complete metadata, duplicate comments, multi-blocker readiness, competing claims, cursor advancement/expiry and bounds all pass. Freeze implementation for complete npm/Bun release gates.
